features.title: Patron and familiar
features.text: Your patron determines your magical tradition and grants distinctive hexes and familiar abilities. Prepare spells through your familiar to fit the day's challenges.

features.title: A coordinated pair
features.text: Use spells, hexes and your familiar's patron ability together. Position the familiar carefully and choose when its special effects help more than another direct attack.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2–3.5 → 2.5–4.5. Tradition and prepared spells allow offensive builds, while many patrons emphasize support.
ratings.defense: 1 → 2. Low HP and no initial armor training encourage protection and positioning.
ratings.support: 3–5 → 3.5–5. Hexes, familiar abilities and chosen spells give strong support options.
ratings.utility: 5 → 3.5–5. Patron tradition and daily preparation determine breadth; not every witch uses the occult list.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Manage prepared spells, hex timing and an active familiar.
